shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
quadruped animal figures in a row
repeated row of similar motifs forming a border
justification: Both surfaces use low relief organised into horizontal registers with a repeated row of like motifs functioning as a band (rosettes in A, a row of crouching quadrupeds/animal heads in B) and both show animals in profile. But A depicts a narrative procession of clothed human tribute-bearers leading horned rams beside a stylised tree with naturalistic modelling and patterned fleece, whereas B has no human figures and shows isolated schematic predators, a bird, and abstract discs arranged without a shared ground line; the conventions of body proportion and detail are quite different.
